usageNotes: Use this endpoint to update node-level settings such as the API server's TLS cipher suites, the UI default language, a notification email address, or an outbound HTTP proxy. All parameters are optional and only the fields you supply are changed; omit a field to leave it unchanged or pass it in 'delete' to revert it to the system default. Requires the System.Modify privilege on /system.

examples.summary: Set an outbound HTTP proxy and notification email for a node

tips: Pass the 'digest' field (SHA256 of the current config) to guard against concurrent modifications — the call fails if another process modified the config between your read and write.
To revert a setting to its default, include the property name in the 'delete' array rather than leaving it blank.
TLS cipher changes take effect after the PDM API service restarts; they do not apply to already-established connections.
Use 'localhost' as the node name when calling from the node itself, but always use the actual node name when calling from a remote client to avoid ambiguity.
